card.name: End of a drug name before its dosage form
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug's name, just before the dosage form or salt that follows it (tablets, sublingual film, Tartrate, A). It also fires on 'and' between two drug names in a combination product.

modes.label: Name ending before form
modes.description: The final piece of a split drug name, right before the dosage form or salt word.
modes.example: titrating Levorphan<<ol>> Tartrate Tablets and when Levor

modes.label: Linking word in a combination
modes.description: The word 'and' or a numeral joining a drug name to its partner or next part.
modes.example: stable dose of Hydrocodone Polistirex<< and>> Chlorpheniramine Polistirex

card.plain: It fires as a drug's name is finishing, when a word like tablets or tartrate is about to follow.
